author: blu
body: draw-text, draw-rect, clear and set-pixel were declared as operations of the Display effect in Foreword chapter Display with no handler anywhere in the tree, so a call type-checked clean and then died at the end of emit with CDX2040. A name the compiler promises and cannot keep is worth less than no name. They are real here, and they are not in the foreword, for the reason that decides it: a display driver writes to the framebuffer, the framebuffer lives behind codex.os, and a foreword chapter may not depend on codex.os. A chapter that wants them cites this one -- exactly as Network's fetch lives in Net chapter HttpFetch.
